A map of two lists: three records, with a str, a bool, an int and a null among their members and a member that only some records hold, and four labels, one of them the empty str. filter, find, any and all run with each of the library's three predicates. The calls compare the text of a str, of a bool, of an int and of a null, the text of a path that holds nothing and of one that holds a list, and the text of the member itself, with a text, with no text, with a prefix and with no prefix.
